title: Senior or Lead Product Designer
description:
Join ShopMy - Powering the Future of Digital Marketing

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love-driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.

ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

We're seeking a Senior or Lead Product Designer who combines exceptional UI craft with a strong builder mentality. This is someone who doesn't just design what's asked-they help shape what should be built in the first place.

You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to take ideas from discovery through polished, high-quality execution, balancing user needs, business goals, and technical constraints every step of the way. You're comfortable supporting research, exploring opportunities, prototyping solutions, and iterating quickly while maintaining a high bar for craft, accessibility, and detail.

• Think beyond design deliverables , proactively identifying opportunities to improve workflows, product quality, and customer experience across creators, brands, and shoppers.

• Prototype and experiment to validate ideas quickly, communicate concepts clearly, and reduce uncertainty before development.

• Leverage modern AI tools and emerging workflows to accelerate design, QA, prototyping, and execution while maintaining a high standard of quality.

• Collaborate in critiques and product discussions , giving thoughtful feedback while continuously raising the bar for the team.

• Contribute to and evolve our design system , ensuring consistency, scalability, and accessibility.

• Maintain exceptional craft and attention to detail , delivering polished experiences that feel intentional from concept to launch.

• Stay curious about new tools, technologies, and product patterns , helping evolve how our team designs and builds.

What We’re Looking For

• 7+ years of product design experience, ideally in a startup or fast-moving product environment.

• A portfolio demonstrating exceptional design, visual craft, and product thinking.

• Experience designing across web, mobile, and responsive platforms.

• A builder mindset-you enjoy solving problems beyond the interface and aren't afraid to jump into unfamiliar territory.

• Strong product intuition with the ability to balance user needs, business objectives, and technical constraints.

title: Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description:
The Mission
Cyberattack runs on internet infrastructure. DomainTools maps it, and has for over 25 years.
The world's most advanced security teams rely on DomainTools to identify malicious infrastructure before it's used against them. We're not a company coasting on legacy. We're in an active growth phase: shipping new products, expanding our intelligence platform well beyond our DNS roots, and positioning at the center of where cybersecurity is heading in the age of AI.
Today, DomainTools delivers a comprehensive internet intelligence platform covering domains, IPs, hostnames, SSL certificates, passive DNS, real-time threat feeds, and AI-native integrations, with visibility into 97% of the internet. Our Iris platform, DNSDB, real-time threat feeds, and MCP Server are the intelligence backbone for security teams at Fortune 500 companies, U.S. federal agencies, and the world's most sophisticated SOCs.
We're not chasing a category. We define it, and we're accelerating.
The Opportunity
DomainTools is at an inflection point. Strong product-market fit. A platform expanding rapidly in capability and scope. A market shifting decisively toward AI-native security operations, where agentic SOC workflows are moving from concept to production and where the retirement of legacy threat intelligence platforms is creating a window of competitive opportunity that favors us.
This role owns how that intelligence is positioned, launched, and sold.
You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Research, Sales, and Demand Generation. You'll turn intelligence, and investigative capability into clear narratives for practitioners and economic buyers, then put those narratives into the assets the field actually uses. You'll write battle cards that sales reps reach for in competitive deals. You'll build launch plans that ship with a narrative, enablement, and a measured result. You'll know the threat intelligence market well enough to brief an analyst or a sales engineer without a handler in the room.
What You'll Own
Positioning and Messaging

• Own the narrative for assigned products and use cases, including investigation, threat hunting, fraud and brand protection, detection enrichment, and API-first data consumption. Keep it current as the product and market evolve.

• Write for two audiences at once: the SOC analyst or threat hunter who has to trust the data, and the CISO or SOC Director who has to justify the spend.

• Maintain the messaging framework so the website, sales team, partners, and campaigns all say the same thing and mean it.

• Translate technical depth into buyer language without flattening what makes DomainTools different: 25+ years of data, predictive Risk Scoring, guided infrastructure pivots, and AI-native access via the MCP Server.

Launches and Go-to-Market

• Plan and run go-to-market for product launches and major releases in partnership with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Demand Generation.

• Define the full launch package: audience, narrative, asset list, enablement plan, and how you'll know it worked. Not just an announcement.

• Translate the roadmap into a launch calendar the rest of the team can execute against, with enough lead time to do it well.

• Own the AI and agentic SOC narrative as a launch pillar in its own right, positioning the MCP Server, AI-native workflows, and the shift from analyst-assisted to autonomous investigation as a coherent, compelling story for the market.

Sales and Partner Enablement

• Build the field kit: first-call decks, solution briefs, battle cards, talk tracks, objection handlers, demo narratives, and proof points. Assets sales uses without rewriting.

• Train sales and solutions engineering on positioning, competitive differentiation, and how to run a compelling DomainTools demonstration.

• Join deals when the narrative needs an owner, including competitive situations, strategic accounts, and moments where the right framing changes the outcome.

description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Billing team sits at the intersection of product, finance, and infrastructure. They're responsible for ensuring every observable event-errors, logs, traces, tokens-gets accurately measured, priced, and billed. Their work directly impacts company revenue and customer trust, requiring distributed systems expertise, attention to financial accuracy, and deep understanding of product usage patterns. The team works cross-functionally with product, engineering, BizOps, marketing, and sales to build systems that enable new products and pricing models.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will architect and scale the core systems that power Sentry's billing infrastructure, ensuring accuracy and reliability at massive scale.

 

- You will collaborate on building the next generation of Sentry’s usage tracking pipeline, processing hundreds of billions of events daily with low latency and financial-grade accuracy.

- You will help design flexible pricing primitives that support everything from per-event usage billing to complex enterprise contracts, enabling product and sales teams to experiment rapidly while maintaining revenue accuracy and reduced time-to-market for new products.

- You will contribute to technical decisions on data consistency challenges unique to billing-like handling event delays, retroactive pricing changes, and distributed count reconciliation across our infrastructure.

YOU'LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

- Want to solve the "easy to explain, hard to build" problems-like ensuring a customer's bill matches their usage perfectly, even when processing hundreds of billions of events daily across distributed systems.

- Thrive on constraints that force elegant design: financial accuracy is non-negotiable, customer trust depends on billing transparency, and the system must scale with Sentry's user and product growth without rearchitecting every year.

- Enjoy partnering across the organization-from BizOps and sales to marketing and leadership-where your code directly impacts ARR and your architectural decisions show up in board-level metrics.

TO THRIVE IN THIS ROLE, YOU HAVE

- Built or significantly improved systems with high-stakes accuracy requirements.

- Mentored engineers through ambiguous, high-stakes projects.

- Operated services where reliability includes uptime and also financial correctness.

title: Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator.

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance.

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)

• Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler

• Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime

• Improve code generation for x86_64 and AArch64

• Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions

• Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense

What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)

• 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering

• Strong C++ design and coding skills

• Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations

• Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another

Very Nice to Have

• Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8

• Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler

• Knowledge of x86_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture

• Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals

• MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

Second, you’ll own our sales process for every opportunity that comes to us through referrals, partners, RFPs, our website and marketing. You won’t do it alone: our senior team joins larger pursuits as executive sponsors and subject-matter experts, our technical strategists and client strategists help shape solutions, and you’ll start from proposal templates and a library of past work. But each pursuit is yours to own.

•

title: Member of Strategic Staff, Model Ecosystem
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

*Open to hiring remote across the US - we also have offices in New York, San Francisco, Seattle, London, Paris, and Tel Aviv.

Runway is rapidly building the leading ecosystem of generative models, bringing the best models from AI labs around the world to our users alongside our own. We are looking for an IC to source, activate, and scale relationships across Runway's growing portfolio of model partners. This is a role for someone who wants to own whatever needs owning, take new models from first conversation to launch, and write the playbook where none exists yet. You will work closely across Engineering, Product, Legal, Finance, and Marketing.

- Own a broad portfolio of model partners end to end, across modalities

- Track the model landscape relentlessly: spot new labs and releases early and bring the strongest ones to the team as candidates for integration

- Build deep, trusted relationships with founders, BD leads and research teams at our partners, and turn those relationships into early access, better terms and joint launches

- Run the portfolio with rigor: set check-in cadences, monitor relationship health, and spot and escalate risk early

- Track usage, spend and margin by partner and model, and use that data to decide where to invest, renegotiate or step back

- Partner with Marketing and our partners on co-marketing for model launches

- Build the frameworks and tools that let the function scale as the ecosystem grows

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 5+ years of experience across some combination of partnerships, business development, GTM, consulting, or founding/operating, with a track record of having owned outcomes end to end

- Experience negotiating commercial agreements, ideally usage-based, API or platform deals

- Genuine obsession with generative AI: you know the labs, you try new models the day they ship, and you have opinions on what makes one good

- Demonstrated range: you've done the deal and the integration and the launch

- High technical aptitude for understanding complex technologies, tools, systems, and issues

- Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to turn usage and spend data into a clear recommendation

- Ability to manage many relationships and priorities at once in a fast-paced environment without dropping threads

- Clear, concise communication, from a startup founder to a big-lab partnerships team to a Runway engineer in the same day

- A strong bias towards action and belief that no task is too small for you

- Highly resourceful, with the ability to create structure and work autonomously amid ambiguity

- New York-based preferred

title: Senior EPC Physical Substation Engineer
description:
Leidos Energy’s , EPC Solutions group, part of Electric Transmission and Substation Solutions, is looking for a Senior Substation Physical Engineer to lead physical design on transmission and distribution substations for electric utility clients nationwide. You’ll own yard layout, grounding, station service, cabling, and design for substation at voltages up to 500kV and 765kV from concept through construction support, and you’ll work side by side with construction and procurement teams to deliver designs that are efficient to build. This is a great fit if you enjoy finding smarter, lower-cost design solutions and seeing your work built in the field.
As a Leidos employee, you can look forward to a dynamic & collaborative culture, as well as managers who will encourage career development and growth opportunities , including:

• Project Management Professional (PMP)

• Professional Engineer (PE) Licensure

• Formal Mentorship programs

• Developmental Leadership training

• Technical Upskilling Opportunities

• Management opportunities

All while supporting your overall well-being and providing flexible work arrangements.
In this role, you can expect to:

• Serve as a Substation Physical Engineer supporting the engineering and design of utility transmission and distribution substations, with primary responsibility for outdoor substation physical design on EPC projects.

• Develop and review substation physical design packages including equipment layouts, electrical plan and section drawings, grounding plans and details, conduit and cable routing, foundation layouts, steel structure arrangements, bus configurations, and material specifications for small to medium-sized utility substation projects.

• Perform engineering calculations related to substation physical design, including grounding analysis, conductor sizing, bus and equipment clearances, rigid and strain bus design, structure loading, and foundation requirements.

• Identify and recommend cost-saving alternatives, such as optimizing bus and equipment arrangements to cut steel, foundation, and conductor quantities, reducing yard footprint or construction hours, and adjusting designs when procurement lead times or vendor options change.

• Read, interpret, and develop substation physical drawings such as one-line diagrams, plan and elevation views, equipment layouts, grounding layouts, conduit plans, cable trench layouts, and construction details.

• Coordinate closely with Protection & Control, SCADA, Civil/Structural, Transmission Line, and other engineering disciplines to ensure an integrated and constructible design solution.

• Assist senior engineers with engineering studies, site evaluations, constructability reviews, and technical design assessments.

• Prepare project deliverables including engineered drawings, design calculations, technical reports, material take-offs, project correspondence, and construction support documentation.

• Evaluate the impacts of design changes across multiple disciplines and recommend technically sound and cost-effective solutions.

• Perform Quality Control reviews of physical design deliverables for smaller projects.

• Support proposal development efforts by providing drawing counts, scope input, manhour estimates, and technical support for substation physical engineering activities.

• Assist in the development and continuous improvement of engineering processes, design standards, and best practices to enhance project execution efficiency.

• Maintain accurate project records, calculations, and design files while ensuring a high level of organization and attention to detail.

• Continue to expand technical knowledge of substation physical design, equipment applications, industry standards, and utility practices.

• Develop and deliver technical presentations and knowledge-sharing sessions to support team development and training initiatives.

• Provide engineering support during procurement, construction, commissioning, and field

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

You’ll work cross-functionally to deliver insight-driven strategies that optimise performance, drive responsible growth, and put the customer at the heart of decision-making.

Your impact

Use strategic analysis to shape and influence broader business strategy.

title: Learning Experience (LX) Platform Manager
locationText: Aurora, Colorado, United States; Aurora +8 more
description:
ABOUT HELLOFRESH GROUP

At HelloFresh, we want to change the way people eat forever by offering our customers high-quality food and recipes for different meal occasions. Over the past decade, we've grown from a single meal kit brand into a global food solutions group - the world's leading meal kit company, active in 18+ countries across 3 continents.

The HelloFresh Group includes HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Factor (ready-to-eat), Chefs Plate, and Youfoodz. Each brand serves a distinct audience but shares our commitment to making good food accessible and sustainable. Our Distribution Centers are the operational heartbeat of everything we deliver - and equipping the people who work in them with the right training, at the right time, in the right format, is fundamental to how we operate.

ABOUT THE ROLE: WHAT'S IN THE BOX

The Learning Platform Manager is the connective tissue between the content our Training Content team creates and the learners who need it. This is a hands-on, operationally grounded role responsible for the health, configuration, and strategic growth of our 360Learning platform across a multi-brand, multi-site network - while also serving as the primary coordination point for training program rollout, stakeholder alignment, and platform-enabled learning design.

You will own the platform end-to-end: user management, course architecture, learning path design, integrations, reporting, and the continuous improvement of how learning is experienced by our Tier 1 DC associates and operational leaders. You will partner daily with the Training Content Manager to translate finished content into published learning experiences, and with Operations, HR, Safety, and OpEX to ensure training is reaching the right people at the right time.

This role is also a direct manager - you will lead and develop one Senior Learning Experience Designer, who shares responsibility for platform administration and content quality support. Together, you are the function that makes the entire training ecosystem visible, measurable, and continuously improving.

 

Scope Area

Details

Platform

360Learning (primary LMS) - full administrative ownership; Workday integration (in progress) for automated enrollment and user management

Brands & Sites

All 4 brands (HelloFresh, EveryPlate, Green Chef, Factor) across all current and future US DC sites; EU and ANZ expansion planned

Learner Audience

Tier 1 DC associates, line leads, supervisors, operational management, and corporate staff

Content Interface

Receives content from Training Content Specialists and VDM team; publishes, structures, and optimizes for learner delivery within 360Learning

Reporting

Completion tracking, compliance records, engagement analytics, and learning program effectiveness reporting to operations and leadership

Integrations

Workday HRIS (in implementation); future integrations as platform scales globally

Geographic Scope

US operations at launch; EU and ANZ expansion as the global program matures

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO: THE RECIPE

Platform Ownership & Administration

• Own the 360Learning platform as its primary administrator: user accounts, group hierarchies, role permissions, course catalog organization, and system configuration across all brands and sites

• Manage and maintain the Workday-360Learning integration, ensuring automated enrollment, role-based course assignment, and learner data accuracy as employees onboard, transfer, or change roles across the network

• Define and govern the platform architecture: group structures, learning path frameworks, program-level organization, and the naming and tagging conventions that keep a multi-brand, multi-site catalog navigable at scale

• Monitor platform health: identify enrollment gaps, stalled learner progress, broken content links, and course configuration issues before they become operational problems

• Manage platform vendor relationship with 360Learning - serve as the primary contact

title: Quality Manager, Software and Regulated AI (m/f/d)
description:
ESQlabs is an innovative, internationally active Contract Research Organization (CRO) and a global leader in the development and application of the Open Systems Pharmacology (OSP) Suite. We combine mechanistic modeling, Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK) and Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP), with software and training to support Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) and Next-Generation Risk Assessment (NGRA) for pharmaceutical, chemical, and academic partners worldwide. Our mission is to empower life sciences: helping scientists understand mechanisms of disease and chemical toxicity to optimize individualized, safer, and more efficient treatment and testing strategies.
As a scientific consultancy serving regulated industries, the quality and traceability of our work are central to our value proposition. We are now extending that discipline from documents and reports to software: we are building an automated, AI agent-orchestrated platform for regulated modeling workflows, and we need it to be qualifiable from the first step, rather than validated retrospectively.

About the Role
You build the quality function for a platform that will be certified, not just validated. You own the quality management system, the validation approach for an agent-orchestrated scientific system, the test plan and test reports, and the traceability from requirement to design to test to record. You define the standards; the platform engineers implement them. You report to the CEO, and you start with an interim consultant already in place and a build team that has written its first requirements and glossary.

You Will

• Own the quality management system and lead its certification (ISO 9001 first; information security and AI management standards follow), designed as one integrated system.

• Own validation of the platform under GAMP 5 second edition and computer software assurance: requirements with stable identifiers, test plan, test reports, traceability, supplier assessment.

• Define and govern the boundary for AI: where a language model may draft, where it may never execute, what evidence every automated step must leave behind, and when the system may run without a human in the loop.

• Own the certification framework for our analyses: reference case sets, conformance testing, the certificate register and its lifecycle, hosting of independent audits.

• Run internal audits and corrective actions, advise scientific teams on ICH M15 deliverables, and track AI regulation (EU AI Act, FDA and EMA guidance) into practical requirements.

What You Bring

• A software background: you have shipped code and can read a repository, a test suite and a CI pipeline without translation. This is the single most important requirement.

• Several years of quality management or computerized system validation in a regulated setting (CRO, pharma, biotech, medical software), with working knowledge of GAMP 5, ALCOA+, 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11.

• Experience taking an organization through at least one certification audit (ISO 9001 or ISO/IEC 27001), from certification body selection to closure of findings.

• A working understanding of how language model agents behave in practice (tool calling, non-determinism, prompt injection) and the ability to explain to an auditor how a system with deterministic and non-deterministic parts is qualified.

Importante: este rol requiere inglés B2 o superior (escrito y oral). Trabajarás a diario con equipos en Estados Unidos, y gran parte de tu trabajo (herramientas, políticas, casos y reuniones) será en inglés. Si tu nivel de inglés es B1 o inferior, este rol no es para ti en este momento.

Acerca del rol

Como Practicante de Prevención de Fraude, harás parte de nuestro equipo de Shopper Risk Operations, el equipo que mantiene a Sezzle seguro para compradores y comercios. Revisarás actividad marcada por nuestros sistemas de detección de fraude y por Customer Support, decidirás qué es fraude y qué no, y nos ayudarás a detectar nuevos patrones de fraude antes de que se propaguen. Trabajarás junto a analistas, científicos de datos e ingenieros, y verás cómo funciona la prevención de fraude dentro de una fintech de rápido crecimiento que cotiza en bolsa.

Buscamos un/a practicante talentoso/a y motivado/a, que combine un alto coeficiente intelectual con una alta inteligencia emocional. No necesitas experiencia previa en fraude; te capacitaremos. La curiosidad, la atención al detalle y el buen criterio importan más.

Es una práctica remunerada, de tiempo completo y remota: de lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a. m. a 5:30 p. m. hora local.

Lo que harás

• Revisar transacciones y cuentas marcadas por posible fraude o abuso

• Investigar casos con nuestras herramientas y políticas internas, y decidir si bloquearlos o aprobarlos

• Buscar patrones en los datos de cuentas y transacciones

• Compartir tus hallazgos para mejorar nuestras reglas y modelos de detección de fraude

• Gestionar tu cola de casos a tiempo y dejar notas claras

• Ayudar a resolver escalamientos de equipos internos

Lo que aprenderás

Lo que buscamos
